messages:
sam-sales: RFP from Zephyr Pay. They want a 3-week pilot with Private VPC, per-tenant isolation, HSM-backed keys optional, and strict p99 latency on fraud scoring endpoints. RFP here: https://drive.company/zephyrpay-rfp.pdf
nina-solutions: Do they specify qps/seq-length? We need that to size the pool.
sam-sales: In appendix: ~600 qps per scoring endpoint, 5 endpoints. p99 < 200ms target.
omar-eng: For POC propose Dedicated 6x GPU baseline + autoscale policy. We'll include intelligent batching and KV cache.
tia-security: HSM requires enterprise addendum; we can support customer-managed KMS now. Will draft security answers: encryption in transit (mTLS), at rest (AES-256), key rotation, and audit log exports.
reed-product: Pricing: they asked for line-item POC quote (infra, eng support hours, logs). I'll draft tiers: dev, pilot, prod.
nina-solutions: I'll assemble the capability matrix rows: VPC peering, private control plane, tenant isolation, KMS/HSM, audit retention (30/90/365), SOC2/FedRAMP notes, API gateway integration (mTLS).
omar-eng: Example perf snippet to include in SOW: {"autoscale_step_qps":400, "add_units":2, "batch_max":128, "latency_target_ms":150}.
tia-security: Also include SIEM connectors (syslog, S3), and note HSM attestation timeline (~5 business days for legal/infra).
ops-bot: Attached: zephyr-cap-matrix.csv (https://files.company/cap-matrix/2067001234.csv)
sam-sales: Action items: Nina = RFP answers + matrix; Omar = perf config + SOW draft; Tia = security questionnaire; Reed = pricing. I'll tell Zephyr we can return a draft packet by Thu EOD. :thumbsup:
reed-product: I'll review SLA language when SOW draft is up.
ops-bot: Thread pinned to #sales for tracking.
